summary: services_down runs .harness/teardown.sh (TEARDOWN_CMD) under timeout -k 10s 2m, stops harness-<run>-svc, notes once per started init; on finish and in the EXIT trap, which first ignores TERM/INT/HUP and stops the running session's scope. verify re-inits after a memory wait. Stubs kill a stopped scope's tree. Template, README, arch, decision. Tests 274 → 277.
verified_how: 3 new checks, each seen RED on a snapshot (finish teardown→stop→one note on demo; a TERM to run termed's driver mid-session: session scope stop < teardown < svc stop, no stub claude left, ended/driver.pid; lowmem: every session before finish starts with svc up). bash tests/run.sh 277/277; lib/check.sh green in 470 s; no harness-test-* unit left.

discoveries.text: verify() now does `mem_gate || run_init` (pulled forward from L2-04: with a real services_down the gate after verify's run_init stopped the services before the verify session). L2-04 only needs to rename mem_gate's `services_down memory` to `memory wait` and add its checks; the lowmem run notes `services stopped (memory)` until then.

The suite's project now has an executable .harness/teardown.sh writing $HARNESS_SCRATCH/teardown-<why-safe>.marker and a `teardown\n<run>\n<why>` record into systemd.log; helpers sd_last (last record index) and svc_gaps <run> (sessions started with svc down) are in tests/run.sh. Every run in proj now notes `services stopped (<finish reason>)`.

stub-systemd-run.sh runs its command in the background (<&0 keeps stdin) with the pid in <unit>.cmd; stub-systemctl stop TERMs that pid and its descendants (parents first) plus .pids. Run termed (TERMed mid-session, STUB_SLOW_CODING=30) is left ended in state with an uncommitted `services stopped (driver exited)` in its harness-log.md, which L2-05's status/gc checks can use.

Review findings left for L2-06: a TERM during run_init runs the teardown while the init may still be starting containers; a TERM during finish's own teardown runs a second teardown concurrently; TEARDOWN_CMD is picked at load_config, so a teardown.sh added mid-run is seen only after a config reload; the trap's note stays uncommitted after a kill.

proposed_changes: L2-03 step 3 names one teardown.marker; the plan's hook writes one per why (teardown-done.marker here) and orders teardown and stop in systemd.log rather than by mtime (plan §11).
L2-04 step 1's verify `mem_gate || run_init` is done in L2-03.
